purpose: Use documented API-v2 CPU creation after the separate v1 capacity refusals; retain native science, payload, prices and budget
memory_request_semantics: No memory field in CreateCpuConfig: catalog ramGbPerVcpu*32 and returned cpu.memory must equal256
budget_note: At most one actual CPU resource,2.10*2700/3600=1.575 USD reported compute. No enlargement of RESOURCE-AMENDMENT-11 total ceiling3.375 USD; storage/network invoice remains unmeasured
public_source_gate: Before credentials/API creation: locally pinned bytes and unauthenticated HTTPS download must match exact payload hash/size; retain proof URL/hash/time/no-Authorization flag
cpu_evidence_label: CPU-only closure control; not GPU acceleration or full IC benchmark
price_guard: Both selected catalog quotes and each allocated pod's positive finite cost<=2.10, exact CPU ID/32vCPU/256GB, secure cloud and image checked; EXITED/ERROR/TERMINATED never treated as ready zero-cost resources
allocation_policy: One POST per flavor, cpu3m then cpu5m only after explicit400/403 refusal and complete exact-name reconciliation;422/402/429/5xx or ambiguous response never causes an automatic second POST
ownership: Durable fresh-name intent and detached watchdog armed BEFORE POST; persist exact returned ID immediately. Ambiguity reconciliation requires unique fresh name AND matching ephemeral service nonce, never name-only adoption
crash_and_disk_guards: Atomic exclusive receipt publication; watchdog-ready acknowledgement required before POST; malformed ownership falls back to exact-name+nonce reconciliation; diagnostic disk failures never stop paid-resource cleanup retries
watchdog_compatibility: ownership.json retains id/name/started_unix/maximum_seconds plus api_base/delete_url/expires_unix; separate watchdog --ownership accepts exact-ID receipt. Automatic --intent watchdog also handles delayed/ambiguous creation
cleanup: Main finally deletes exact owned ID and requires GET404. Independent process reconciles only request-attributable IDs and retries DELETE/exact-ID404 verification with backoff until absence. No unrelated pod mutation
deadline_limit: Deletion starts by2400s with300s reserve before2700s target. The v2 schema supplies no provider TTL: provider/API outage can defeat a hard billing deadline; record deadline_exceeded and keep cleanup alive instead of claiming the cap was guaranteed
transport: Provider and authenticated evidence requests reject redirects to prevent Authorization forwarding; public source proof is a separate unauthenticated request
secrets: Provider key read only in explicit execute/watchdog/cleanup modes, never sent to pod or written/logged. HTTP nonce exists only in memory/provider env/local detached-watchdog env; persisted request records redact it
evidence: Exclusive new output directory, separate refusal receipts per candidate, per-poll status files, size/hash checked archive extracted into a fresh namespace; never overwrite old refusal/outcome or remote/run-cpu-v3 files
publication_before_launch: Root publishes/reviews this prospective source/amendment and explicitly launches later; this task uses no credentials/provider calls and provisions nothing
